reasoning: The evidence shows SDS led by Janša consistently leads in polls (22-23% vs Golob's 18-19%), with the right-wing bloc projected to potentially reach 45 seats (needing 46 for majority). Golob faces corruption allegations and political scandals. However, the margin is narrow, there are many undecided voters (19.7%), and tensions exist between Janša and other right-wing parties (notably Logar's Democrats). Resni.ca has rejected cooperation with SDS. The right bloc reaching exactly 45 seats would still fall short. Coalition formation remains uncertain even if SDS wins the most seats.
